decisions.reason: As a flagship digital patient intake and consent line tightly linked to the firm’s core practice software, compliance know-how, and integration capabilities, it fits the firm’s absorptive capacity very well and is likely to be further improved rather than withdrawn.

The education institute is somewhat less central than software but still builds on the firm’s practitioner knowledge, training resources, and customer relationships, so a growing firm would more likely retain it as a complementary offering than shut it down quickly.

A remote screen-sharing support tool is closely related to the firm’s established support and software service capabilities, making it easy to absorb, use, and refine as part of serving dental practices efficiently.
